'''Voostaggano''', also known as '''Voostaggano the Indomitable''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who was a champion [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]]. The night before a showdown with the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] gladiator [[Bowdaar]], Voostaggano's appetite had caused him to ingest a [[Blood parasite/Legends|blood parasite]]. As a result of this, Voostaggano's match with Bowdaar was forced to be delayed and the Wookiee gladiator was declared the victor by default when Voostaggano never recovered from his illness.<ref name="TOR Encyclopedia" />
